cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow the dress for ten pounds and admit you mocked it. I taught you to judge the cut before sneering at the colour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can count the price, at least. Keep the extra ten. It doesn't tell me what happened to your 'dreadful taste' remark.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ten pounds, and tell the people you said it to who chose it. You used to need me to finish every seam; now you can finish that compliment where they can hear it.
